out_text: R2148: every existing discovery door makes the caller state the criteria first - api_search needs a keyword, seller, price band or category, api_categories describes what a bucket is made of, api_category_demand asks whether it sells and api_listing_position ranks one listing inside its own bucket - so the buyer's most natural follow-up after opening a listing ('what else is like this one') had no face, and a caller had to read the listing, harvest its category and price, rebuild the neighbour set through api_search and then sort it by hand. apimarket.py now grows api_similar_listings(listing_id, limit=None, include_delisted=False), which pins the definition of 'similar' the market never had: the candidate set is the listing's EFFECTIVE category bucket minus the head, ordered by asking-price distance from the head, then price, then listing_id, so the order is a total order and two equally distant neighbours never swap between calls. Price rides _current_price, rating rides the effective stars, net sales ride the scarcity seam and titles ride the metadata seam, so a repricing, a rating revision, a refund, a restock or a metadata edit moves the neighbour set in the same step it moves every other read face, and no listing row is ever rewritten. An uncategorized head recruits only uncategorized listings (zero cross-bucket permeation) and a retired head stays readable so history is not erased. The pinned gate order is listing shape, then existence, then limit shape, then the include_delisted flag, so an unknown listing answers E_AM_UNKNOWN_LISTING even when the limit or flag is also malformed, and every refusal writes zero rows and moves zero tokens. Laws pinned by AC-AMSI1..AC-AMSI8: the twelve-key envelope and thirteen-key rows with derived price_delta/abs_price_delta and the head never in its own rows, the effective-bucket conservation identity against api_categories, the distance seam with frozen base rows, the retirement switch, the limit law (closest head kept, total always the whole set, five bad forms refused), the gate family and gate order with frozen table digests and a constant ledger tx set, the pure-read law with same-call byte identity, and cross-restart byte identity on three instances.
